infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RESQ Nepal uses your location to set pickup points and, during an assigned trip, share the ambulance's live position with that booking's patient.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: RESQ Nepal uses your location to set pickup points and, during an assigned trip, share the ambulance's live position with that booking's patient.

plugins.photosPermission: RESQ Nepal accesses your photos only when you choose a profile picture or an identity document.
plugins.cameraPermission: RESQ Nepal uses the camera only when you take a profile picture or photograph an identity document.
